plots.farmLocation: Dindori Road, Near Gangapur Dam, Nashik, Maharashtra
plots.plotName: Riverbed Black Soil Terrace Block A
plots.soilType: Fertile Deep Black Cotton Soil (Riverbed Alluvial)
plots.description: Prime river-facing plot enriched with decomposed cow-dung manure and vermicompost for 5 continuous seasons. Equipped with automated drip emitters and solar fencing. Consumer funding covers organic seeds, micro-nutrients, water, power, and our daily dedicated farm labour.
plots.termsNote: Land ownership remains solely with Rajesh Kumar Patil. Consumer retains 100% legal entitlement to the harvested produce and proceeds thereof.

plots.farmLocation: Dindori Road, Near Gangapur Dam, Nashik, Maharashtra

plots.description: Dedicated raised beds with UV stabilized black/silver mulch. Ideal for winter strawberry plantation or exotic sweet corn. Complete caretaking, weeding, pollination management, and harvesting will be handled by our experienced team.
plots.termsNote: Land ownership remains solely with farmer. Consumer owns all harvest rights and can either take produce or sell in marketplace.
